name: Plain prompts in a busy stretch get small, silent faces
case: Boop is in a good mood and the person is busy with several agents, a prompt every half minute or so. The first two sound like something, one polite and one playful, and each gets a face, the playful one a sign too, though they come seconds apart. Then an agent gets stuck and Boop is put out by it. Over the next couple of minutes the person sends three plain requests, each a paragraph, calm, with nothing in how they're written that stands out: a fix, a push and a look at the tests. Boop has only just reacted each time, so each gets a small face held once at most, saying nothing and holding up no sign, though a few of the person's words came with each. After five quiet minutes, another plain request gets a face of Boop's own again.
why: PERSONALITY: a plain prompt, one that says nothing of how you sound and doesn't say Boop's name, gets at most a small face in silence, with no sign, if HISTORY shows Boop reacting in the last 3 minutes; the few words of yours under it don't make it stand out. Only a plain one waits for a quiet stretch. Taken from a real stretch where every such prompt held up a sign and most spoke
